title: Upfront AI Capability & Precision Disclosure (Microsoft HAX G1 & G2)
description: Under Microsoft Human-AI Interaction Guidelines (HAX G1 'Make clear what the system can do' and G2 'Make clear how well the system can do what it can do'), AI-powered interfaces must communicate supported tasks upfront via clickable starter prompts/examples and explicitly state accuracy limitations (potential hallucinations, knowledge cutoff, and need to verify critical decisions).
playwright_check_snippet: const aiEls = document.querySelectorAll('[data-ai], [class*="ai-" i], [class*="copilot" i], [class*="assistant" i], [placeholder*="Ask AI" i]'); if (aiEls.length === 0) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; return 'APPLIED_PASS';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Check if the page includes an AI assistant, copilot, generative search, or AI feature. If no AI feature exists on the page, return DOES_NOT_APPLY. If present, verify that it shows concrete starter prompts/examples (G1) and a clear accuracy/limitation notice (G2).
remediation_guide: Render 3–4 clickable starter prompt chips above the AI input ('Compare pricing tiers', 'Summarize report') and a persistent disclaimer below the composer: `'AI responses may contain inaccuracies. Please verify critical financial or legal facts.'`

title: Visible Streaming Progress & Mandatory Human-in-the-Loop Approval for Consequential Actions
description: In Generative AI interfaces (8 GenAI UX Patterns & Google PAIR v3): 1) Long-running responses and tool calls must display live token streaming and expandable multi-step progress indicators (`'Analyzing request... -> Querying database... -> Drafting response'`). 2) Before executing any consequential, financial, destructive, or external-communication AI action, the UI must require explicit human confirmation (`Approve / Cancel`) with a preview of the proposed changes.
playwright_check_snippet: const aiEls = document.querySelectorAll('[data-ai], [class*="ai-" i], [class*="chat" i], [class*="assistant" i]'); if (aiEls.length === 0) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; return 'APPLIED_PASS';
vision_prompt_heuristic: If an AI agent or generative workflow is present on the page, check whether streaming/step-by-step progress indicators and explicit confirmation gates ('Confirm & Execute' / 'Cancel') are provided for consequential actions. If no AI workflow is present, return DOES_NOT_APPLY.
remediation_guide: Stream tokens via SSE/WebSockets with `<ReasoningSteps steps={...} />` (`aria-live='polite'`) and gate all side-effecting tool calls behind an explicit `<ActionApprovalCard diff={proposedChanges} onConfirm={...} onCancel={...} />` dialog.

title: Calibrated Trust: Clickable Source Citations, Categorical Confidence Cues & HAX G11 Security Exception
description: Under Google PAIR v3 (Chapter 4: Explainability + Trust) and Microsoft HAX G11: 1) AI factual claims must include clickable inline source citations (`[1]`), categorical confidence indicators (`High / Medium / Low confidence` rather than false-precision `94.37%`), and example-based explanations. 2) Per the HAX G11 exception, internal security, fraud, and anti-spam detection thresholds must NOT be exposed in the UI to prevent adversarial gaming.
playwright_check_snippet: const aiContainers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-ai-response], [class*="ai-response" i], [class*="citation" i]'); if (aiContainers.length === 0) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; return 'APPLIED_PASS';
vision_prompt_heuristic: If AI-generated answers or recommendations are displayed on the page, verify that clickable source citations and categorical confidence cues are shown, while internal anti-fraud/security rules remain protected (HAX G11). If no AI outputs exist on the page, return DOES_NOT_APPLY.
remediation_guide: Render interactive `<CitationChip href={source.url} title={source.title} />` badges alongside AI claims, use 3-tier categorical confidence labels (`High / Medium / Verify independently`), and abstract internal anti-abuse triggers behind safe high-level notices.

title: Cautious Adaptation — Forbid Live List & Menu Reshuffling While Reading (Microsoft HAX G14)
description: Microsoft HAX G14 ('Update and adapt cautiously') forbids AI personalization from dynamically reordering navigation menus, product grids, or search results while the user is actively reading or moving their pointer toward a target. Adaptive ranking updates must occur only between sessions or when the user explicitly clicks a 'Refresh Recommendations' control.
vision_prompt_heuristic: Verify that recommendation feeds, navigation bars, or search lists do not abruptly reshuffle or shift under the user's pointer, and that any incoming live updates use a non-intrusive 'Show N new items' pill banner at the top.
remediation_guide: Buffer asynchronous ranking updates in background state and display a non-intrusive `<Button>Show 3 new recommendations</Button>` pill banner instead of mutating live DOM order under the user's cursor.

title: Granular Feedback (HAX G15), Non-Destructive Refinement & Explicit Context/Memory Reset
description: Per Microsoft HAX G15 ('Encourage granular feedback') and the 8 GenAI Patterns: every AI output must provide granular feedback controls (thumbs up/down + reason tags), retry/fallback controls to standard UI, non-destructive prompt editing/branching without losing prior outputs, and an explicit control to inspect or reset AI context/memory ('Reset Context / Clear Memory').
playwright_check_snippet: const aiUi = document.querySelectorAll('[data-ai], [class*="ai-" i], [class*="assistant" i]'); if (aiUi.length === 0) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; return 'APPLIED_PASS';
vision_prompt_heuristic: If an AI interface is present on the page, check whether it provides: 1) thumbs-up/down feedback controls, 2) retry/regenerate or manual fallback controls, 3) non-destructive prompt editing, and 4) a clear 'Reset context / Clear memory' button. If no AI UI is present, return DOES_NOT_APPLY.
remediation_guide: Attach `<AiActionToolbar onRate={...} onRegenerate={...} onEditBranch={...} />` below every AI response and provide a `'Reset Context / New Session'` control in the assistant header.
